battle.name: 唐與高句麗的戰爭
battle.brief: 唐太宗以高句麗弒主篡位為由，集兵造艦，貞觀十八年冬親率大軍東征。牛進達自萊州泛海攻平壤，李世勣率齊州兵與契丹、靺鞨兵出柳城破城十餘，鋒抵遼東安市。城頭所佈弓弩，即卡面亞述長弓一系的複合反曲弓，遠射壓制唐軍攻勢；安市城圍攻不下，糧道屢斷，寒冬與薛延陀入侵迫唐軍退兵。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 這場戰爭橫跨二十餘年，先後有三度交鋒，交戰方是唐與新羅聯軍對高句麗。唐朝一方在體制上以行軍大總管分道並進、以運糧使與州郡租賦維持遠征，兵種以府兵與北衙禁軍為骨幹，並大量徵用契丹、靺鞨等蕃部為附庸兵；海路一支由登州、萊州出發，陸路由柳城、扶餘方向推進。高句麗一方由莫離支淵蓋蘇文攝政，國王寶藏王居平壤山城，國中城邑多附山而築，兵眾以弓弩手、步卒與槍兵為主，兵籍之外另有大量部眾與役夫分屯各城與烽燧，與北方突厥維持聯盟，並以新羅為西南方向的主要競爭者。651年之後高句麗奪取新羅在漢江上游的彌梁等城，新羅武烈王金春秋屢遣使入唐求援，成為唐軍介入的直接契機。661年唐與新羅聯軍滅百濟後，原本獨立的百濟與高句麗、靺鞨的聯盟瓦解，唐高宗一度以六道行軍大總管、二十餘萬大軍合擊平壤，因北方鐵勒來犯而全軍撤回。666年淵蓋蘇文死後，其三子淵男生、淵男建、淵男產爭位，內亂與饑荒同時爆發，唐軍乘虛而入，新羅在南部攻取熊津、浿水一線，兩面夾擊之下高句麗於668年崩解，唐分其地為九都督府、四十二州、一百縣，於平壤置安東都護府統之。
countriesEn: This war ran over more than two decades and was fought in three campaigns, between a Tang-Silla alliance on one side and Goguryeo on the other. On the Tang side the war was run institutionally through line commanders, the xingjun dazongguan, who advanced along separate roads, and sustained by a commissioner of supplies and by the revenue of the prefectures; the troops were drawn from the fubing and the Northern Palace Guard, with large numbers of Khitan and Mohe auxiliaries taken into Tang service. One column went by sea from Dengzhou and Laizhou, the other overland from Liucheng and the Fuyu direction. Goguryeo was governed by the mollichi, Yu Ge Suwen, as regent, while the king, the Treasure King, sat in the mountain city of Pyongyang; the towns of the country were for the most part built against the hills, the field forces were archers, crossbowmen, spearmen and lancers, and beyond the military registers stood a great mass of dependants and levy labour posted to the towns and the beacon towers. Goguryeo kept an alliance with the Turks in the north and counted Silla as its principal rival to the south-west. After 651 it took the Silla-held towns such as Miryang on the upper Han River, and Silla's King Mulgil Kim Chunch'ung sent envoys to the Tang court again and again asking for help, which gave the Tang intervention its immediate occasion. After the Tang and Silla destroyed Baekje in 661, the old coalition of Baekje, Goguryeo and Mohe fell apart, and the Tang Gaozong once mustered commanders for six roads and more than two hundred thousand men against Pyongyang, only for the incursion of the Tiele in the north to force the whole force back. When Yu Ge Suwen died in 666, his three sons, Yu Nan Seong, Yu Nam Geon and Yu Nan Chan, fought over the succession, factional strife and famine broke out together, the Tang army moved into the gap, and Silla drove north from the south. Under this two-sided pressure Goguryeo collapsed in 668; the Tang divided its territory into nine military districts, forty-two prefectures and a hundred counties, and set up the Protectorate General to Pacify the East at Pyongyang to govern them.
people: 留下姓名的多數是唐軍將領。唐太宗李世民是這場戰爭的發起者與第一次親征者，《冊府元龜》引他東征前夜之語：『遼東舊中國之有，自北魏魏涉北周，置之度外。隋氏出師者，四喪律而還，殺中國良善不可勝數。今彼弒其主恃險驕盈，朕長夜思之而輟寢，將為中國復子弟之讎，為高麗討弒君之賊。今九瀛大定，唯此一隅。』他親率李世勣、李道宗、長孫無忌等十萬大軍東下，645年受阻安市城而退兵，此後頗悔用兵之失度。李世勣以遼東道行軍大總管總領平壤方向，667年破新城、668年拔扶餘城與大行城，是最後一役的統帥。牛進達領海路一支，647年再自海上攻遼東。契苾何力出身靺鞨，累次隨唐征高句麗：645年為遼東安撫大使，666年率兵八萬迎接出奔的淵男生，667年與李世勣同領十五萬大軍合擊。薛仁貴在顯慶年間破赤烽鎮、橫山，667年用計取南蘇、木底、蒼岩三城，668年破扶餘城，滅國後檢校安東都護、領兵二萬鎮平壤。蘇定方於655年以左衛中郎將渡遼水擊高句麗，662年任平壤道行軍大總管。程名振以營州都督兼東夷都護統軍，658年以契丹兵逆擊高麗大將豆方婁三萬眾，斬首二千五百級。郝處俊為行軍大總管之副，獨孤卿雲出鴨綠道、郭待封出積利道、劉仁願出畢列道，新羅金仁問由海谷道出師，運糧使竇義積掌河北諸州租賦。高句麗方面，642年弒榮留王高建武、立高寶藏為王、自稱莫離支的淵蓋蘇文，是唐軍出兵的直接目標；其子淵男生出奔降唐，淵男建拒守平壤至城破被俘，淵男產奉寶藏王之命出降。安市城守將姓名正史不載，僅韓國民間傳其名為楊萬春。668年九月十二日開平壤城門的是高句麗僧人信誠。新羅方面，金春秋先請唐兵，金庾信在南部率兵攻浿水、熊津，迫使高句麗在南部收縮。
peopleEn: Those who left a name are mostly Tang commanders. The Tang Taizong, Li Shimin, was the man who started the war and led the first personal expedition; the CeFu YuanGui quotes him on the eve of the march: Liaodong was old China, and since the Wei and Zhou dynasties it had been left outside the fold; the Sui went out four times and came home beaten, and the good men of China were killed beyond counting; now they have killed their own ruler and rely on their stronghold and their arrogance, and I lie awake at night over it, and I will avenge the sons and brothers of China and punish the murderer of the king of Goguryeo; the nine regions are at peace and only this corner remains. He took a hundred thousand men east with Li Shiji, Li Daozong and Changsun Wuji, was held up at the city of Anshi in 645 and withdrew, and afterwards was much exercised by the error of his own campaigning. Li Shiji, as commander-in-chief of the Liaodong route, directed the Pyongyang thrust: he took Xincheng in 667 and Fuyu and Daxing in 668, and was the general of the last campaign. Niu Jinda led the sea column and struck at Liaodong from the water again in 647. Qibi Heli, of Mohe origin, campaigned with the Tang against Goguryeo repeatedly: he was commissioner for the pacification of Liaodong in 645, in 666 he led eighty thousand men to receive the fugitive Yu Nan Seong, and in 667 he marched with Li Shiji and a host of a hundred and fifty thousand. Xue Rengui took the fortress of Chifeng and fought at Hengshan in the Xianqing era; in 667 he took Nansu, Mudi and Cangyan by stratagem, in 668 he took Fuyu, and after the fall of the country he was made acting Protector General to Pacify the East and held two thousand men to garrison Pyongyang. Su Dingfang crossed the Liao river as Left Guard Middle Colonel in 655 and was commander of the Pyongyang route in 662. Cheng Mingzhen, military governor of Yingzhou and protector of the Eastern Barbarians, took the field in 658 and struck the three thousand men of the Goguryeo general Dou Fanglou with Khitan troops, cutting off some two thousand five hundred. Hao Chujun was deputy to the commander-in-chief; Dugu Qingyun marched by the Yalu road, Guo Daifeng by the Jili road, Liu Renyuan by the Bilie road and Silla's Kim Imun took the sea valley road, while the commissioner of supplies Dou Yiji handled the revenue of the northern provinces. On the Goguryeo side, Yu Ge Suwen, who killed the king Rongliu, Gao Jianwu, in 642, set up the Treasure King and took the title of mollichi, was the declared target of the Tang expedition. His sons went over to the Tang, Yu Nan Seong fleeing to them, Yu Nam Geon held Pyongyang until the city fell and was taken prisoner, and Yu Nan Chan came out to surrender on the Treasure King's behalf. The name of the garrison commander of Anshi does not survive in the official histories; Korean tradition calls him Yang Wanchun. The man who opened the gate of Pyongyang on the twelfth day of the ninth month of 668 was the Goguryeo monk Sincheng. On the Silla side Kim Chunch'ung asked for Tang troops first, and Kim Gyu-sin drove north in the south along the rivers Kwam and Kumgang, forcing Goguryeo to contract in that quarter.
kits: 卡面這把亞述長弓是短身複合反曲弓一類的兵器，亞述人靠弓與鐵的組合征服兩河流域，弓兵在車上射、車兵靠弓兵開路。放到唐與高句麗的戰場上，它代表的是弓這件冷兵器在東亞兵體系中的位置，而不是一把西亞的實物弓出現在遼東。高句麗是東北亞最重弓的政權之一，隋書記其人好射，善用弓矢與標槍，弓兵與弩手依城垣分層射擊，掩護攻城者，也掩護撤退者。同一類複合弓的技術譜系在靺鞨、渤海與高句麗之間彼此流傳；唐軍的遠程火力主力則是弩，以蹏張弩為主，形制大、張力強，適合固定陣地與攻城，作為弓的補充。唐軍攻城同時備有雲車、巢車這類高車，用以居高觀敵並以弩弓射擊城頭守兵；穴地、填壕、拒馬、橓盾並用，火箭與火油用以燒毀城門與木構樓櫓。長槊與馬槊是唐騎兵的基本兵器，太宗自領的精騎以衝陣破密集步兵為主，卡面所繪亞述弓兵那種車上射擊的配合，在唐軍這裡改由騎手自鞍上射出的騎射承接。唐軍的供應核心是船：萊州與登州所造戰船數百艘，運糧船更倍之，河北諸州租稅悉運遼東。高句麗一方的守備器械以山城、壕塹、女牆與拒馬為主，其弓弩手在城頭與山城射擊位俯瞰攻城路線，箭矢之中亦有用毒者。就整體而言，亞述長弓這一類武器在這場戰爭中的位置，是在城頭與陣前把遠程火力覆蓋到攻城隊形與糧道之上，與弩、槊、攻城器械及海運後勤合為一體。
kitsEn: The bow on the card is of the short composite recurved type, the weapon with which the Assyrians conquered the river valleys of the Two Rivers by the combination of bow and iron, archers shooting from their chariots and the chariot crews following the archers. Placed on the field of the Tang war against Goguryeo, it stands for the place of the bow within the military system of East Asia rather than for an Assyrian weapon physically present in Liaodong. Goguryeo was among the most bow-centred states in Northeast Asia; the Sui Shu records that its people were keen archers and skilled with bow, arrow and javelin, and its archers and crossbowmen shot in layers from the ramparts, covering the assaulting parties and also covering their withdrawal. The same family of composite bow had passed between the Mohe, Balhae and Goguryeo. On the Tang side the backbone of long-range fire was the crossbow: heavy tension-engines of the throttling-pedal type, big and powerful, well suited to fixed positions and to siege work, and serving as the supplement to the bow. For the assault the Tang also had tall wagons of the cloud-cart and nest-cart kinds, used to look down on the enemy and to shoot at the defenders on the walls with bows and crossbows; mining the ground, filling the ditches, and using chevaux-de-frise and mantlets together, while fire arrows and burning oil were used against gates and wooden towers. The long spear and the cavalry lance were the standard weapons of the Tang horse, the picked cavalry led by the emperor himself riding down massed infantry, and the chariot-archer combination drawn on the card is taken over in the Tang army by the mounted archer shooting from the saddle. The core of Tang supply was the ship: several hundred warships were built at Laizhou and Dengzhou, the grain ships were more numerous again, and the revenue of the northern provinces was carried to Liaodong. The defensive works of the Goguryeo side were the mountain city, the ditch, the parapet and the chevaux-de-frise, their archers and crossbowmen shooting down from the walls and from the heights over the approach of the assault, and poisoned arrows were used as well. In the whole, the place of a weapon such as the Assyrian bow in this war was to lay long-range fire over the assaulting formations and the supply lines from the walls and the field, joined up with the crossbow, the lance, the siege engines and the seaborne logistics into a single system.
tactics: 唐軍的戰術主軸是分進合擊與圍城打援。645年，水路由牛進達自萊州浮海入夷水，陸路由李世勣率齊州兵及契丹、靺鞨兵自柳城出嶺，兩路在鴨綠水下游會合，再圖平壤；李世勣在貴髮水一線遇上高句麗太子男建所領的十五萬眾，契苾何力率靺鞨兵在冰雪中苦戰受傷，唐騎兵反覆衝鋒才穩住陣腳，兵鋒一度逼到安市城下。攻城時唐軍以雲車居高射擊城頭，穴地與填壕並進，圍城同時用騎兵遮斷敵軍糧道，試圖以圍打援迫高句麗出城；安市城堅，箭矢如雨，圍攻歷時約三個月仍不能下，糧道屢遭高句麗騎兵抄斷，糧秣不繼，加以深冬苦寒與北方薛延陀入侵，唐軍被迫退兵，撤退時由騎兵殿後掩護，仍有士卒死傷與糧船漂失。668年的進攻比645年更細密：李勣居中，獨孤卿雲出鴨綠道、郭待封出積利道、劉仁願出畢列道、新羅金仁問出海谷道，李勣所部在鴨綠水邊越冬集結後直取平壤，新羅在南線同時進攻，使高句麗首尾不能相顧。平壤守城數月，寶藏王遣淵男產出降、淵男建拒降，最終由僧人信誠開門，唐軍入城。高句麗方的戰術則集中在守城與斷糧：以山城之險、弓弩交叉火力與居高臨下的射擊消耗進攻方，避開唐騎兵的正面衝鋒，不求在野戰中取勝，而以游擊糧道、遲滯攻城與拖延季節取勝，這是它三次抵擋唐軍的核心手段。
tacticsEn: The spine of Tang strategy was the advance by separate roads to converge, and the investment of a besieging force to draw the enemy out. In 645 one column went by sea under Niu Jinda from Laizhou into the Yalu, while the land column under Li Shiji, with the troops of Qizhou and Khitan and Mohe auxiliaries, marched out of Liucheng and across the mountains; the two met below the Yalu and then moved on Pyongyang. On the Guifa river Li Shiji came up against the hundred and fifty thousand men led by the Goguryeo crown prince Yu Nam Geon; the Mohe troops of Qibi Heli fought hard in ice and snow and he was wounded, and only repeated charges by the Tang horse kept the line steady, pushing the advance once up to the walls of Anshi. At the assault the Tang used cloud-carts to shoot down at the defenders, worked the ground under the walls and filled the ditches at the same time, and posted horse to cut the enemy's supply lines, hoping to force Goguryeo to sally so that it could be beaten in the open. Anshi was strong, its arrowfall like rain, and after roughly three months of siege it had not fallen; the supply line was repeatedly cut by Goguryeo horse, the food and fodder ran short, and with the hard cold of deep winter and the invasion of Xueyantuo in the north the Tang had to withdraw, the horse covering the retreat, though men were lost and grain ships drifted away. The offensive of 668 was more finely divided than that of 645: Li Shiji in the centre, Dugu Qingyun by the Yalu road, Guo Daifeng by the Jili road, Liu Renyuan by the Bilie road and Silla's Kim Imun by the sea valley road, with Li Shiji's own force spending the winter on the bank of the Yalu and then driving straight at Pyongyang, while Silla attacked in the south so that Goguryeo could not look to either end. Pyongyang held out for months, the Treasure King sent Yu Nan Chan out to surrender while Yu Nam Geon refused, and at last the monk Sincheng opened the gate and the Tang entered the city. The tactics of Goguryeo were concentrated on the defence of the cities and on the cutting of supplies: using the strength of the mountain cities, the cross-fire of bows and crossbows and the plunging shot from the heights to grind down the attacker, avoiding the Tang horse in the open, seeking no victory in the field, and winning instead by raiding the supply lines, slowing the siege and running out the season. That was the core of the way it three times turned the Tang back.
data: 可核對的數字以兩《唐書》與《資治通鑑》為主。第一次戰爭，唐太宗在洛陽與萊州一帶集兵，諸軍出動約十萬人，新唐書記作十餘萬；戰船數百艘，舊唐書記運糧五十萬石，一度需以河北諸州租稅接濟。645年李世勣部在貴髮水一線遇到的高句麗兵，唐方記為十五萬。安市城自四月至七月被圍約三個月，舊唐書稱圍攻八十八日而不能下，糧盡乃退。退兵時死傷、漂失與被俘者達數百至數千人級，糧船散失無算。高句麗全國的兵籍，新唐書高句麗傳記為城七十餘、戶六十餘萬、兵四十萬，是含部眾與常年役兵的總數，不等於一時可集之戰兵。第二條戰線的數字較小：655年程名振、蘇定方渡遼水；658年薛仁貴、程名振拔赤烽鎮，斬首四百餘級、捕虜百餘人，擊潰豆方婁三萬眾，斬首二千五百級；659年薛仁貴破溫沙門於橫山。661年唐軍一度以十餘萬渡遼水合擊平壤，因鐵勒來犯撤回。666年契苾何力率兵八萬迎淵男生；667年十二月十八日李勣為遼東道行軍大總管兼安撫大使，與契苾何力、龐同善率兵十五萬，河北諸州租賦悉詣遼東給軍用。668年平壤於九月十二日陷落，其後分其境為九都督府、四十二州、一百縣，置安東都護府，薛仁貴領兵二萬鎮之。全役自644年集兵起至668年城破，前後二十五年，其間真正的大規模交鋒只有645年、655至659年、661至662年、667至668年四段。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked come mainly from the two Tang histories and from the Zizhi Tongjian. In the first war the Tang Taizong mustered his troops around Luoyang and Laizhou, and about one hundred thousand men moved out, the New Tang History giving the figure as a hundred thousand odd; there were several hundred warships, and the Old Tang History records the transport of five hundred thousand hu of grain, at one point with the revenue of the northern provinces drawn in to feed the army. The Goguryeo force that met Li Shiji on the Guifa river in 645 is given on the Tang side as a hundred and fifty thousand. Anshi was invested from the fourth to the seventh month, roughly three months; the Old Tang History speaks of eighty-eight days of siege without its falling, and the army withdrew when the food ran out. In the withdrawal men were killed, lost or captured to the number of several hundreds to several thousands, and grain ships were lost beyond reckoning. The registers of Goguryeo as a whole give, in the New Tang History account of the country, some seventy-odd cities, a little over six hundred thousand households and four hundred thousand men, a total that includes dependants and permanent levies and is not the number of men who could be brought into the field at once. The figures on the second line are smaller: in 655 Cheng Mingzhen and Su Dingfang crossed the Liao river; in 658 Xue Rengui and Cheng Mingzhen took the fortress of Chifeng, cutting off some four hundred and taking over a hundred prisoners, and broke the thirty thousand men of Dou Fanglou, cutting off some two thousand five hundred; in 659 Xue Rengui defeated Wen Shamen at Hengshan. In 661 the Tang once crossed the Liao river with more than a hundred thousand men to converge on Pyongyang, and withdrew when the Tiele came over. In 666 Qibi Heli led eighty thousand men to receive Yu Nan Seong; on the eighteenth day of the twelfth month of 667 Li Shiji was appointed commander-in-chief of the Liaodong route and pacification commissioner, and with Qibi Heli and Pang Tongshan led a hundred and fifty thousand men, the revenue of the northern provinces being sent to Liaodong to feed the host. Pyongyang fell on the twelfth day of the ninth month of 668, and the country was then divided into nine military districts, forty-two prefectures and a hundred counties, with the Protectorate General to Pacify the East established and Xue Rengui holding two thousand men there. From the mustering of 644 to the fall of the city in 668 the war ran twenty-five years, and the large engagements proper came to four stretches only: 645, 655 to 659, 661 to 662, and 667 to 668.
cause: 打起來有四層理由。第一層是名分：642年莫離支淵蓋蘇文殺榮留王高建武，另立高寶藏為王而自攝政，唐朝便以『為高麗討弒君之賊』出兵，把干預寫成雪一國之讎。第二層是地緣：631年起高句麗自扶餘城起築長城直抵海邊，與突厥結盟，據遼東與平壤，控扼唐的東北門戶；唐廷自北魏北周以來視遼東為中國故地，隋煬帝三次出師皆大敗而還，太宗以『遼東舊中國之有』自任，把取高句麗視為統一大業的最後一段。第三層是盟友的請援：651年後高句麗攻取新羅在漢江上游的彌梁等地，新羅屢遣使入唐求救，唐由牽制轉為出兵。第四層是自身安全判斷：高句麗境內饑荒與王族相爭同時出現，北方又有鐵勒與薛延陀的壓力，唐廷認為此時出兵代價最小。約束這一切的則是後勤：遠征越海，糧秣由山東轉輸，若不能速戰速決，先垮的必然是唐軍自己。
causeEn: There were four layers of reason for the war. The first was the question of lawful title. In 642 the mollichi Yu Ge Suwen killed the king Rongliu, Gao Jianwu, set up the Treasure King in his place and ruled as regent, and the Tang court therefore went to war under the formula of punishing the murderer of the king of Goguryeo, dressing an intervention as the avenging of a wrong done to a nation. The second was geography. From 631 Goguryeo built a long wall running from the city of Fuyu to the sea, allied itself with the Turks, and held Liaodong and Pyongyang, holding the gate of the Tang empire in the north-east. The Tang court had regarded Liaodong as old Chinese territory since the Wei and Zhou, the Sui Yangdi had gone out three times and been beaten each time, and the Taizong took up the words Liaodong is old China and counted the taking of Goguryeo as the last stage of a unification. The third was the appeal of an ally. After 651 Goguryeo took the Silla towns of the upper Han, such as Miryang, and Silla sent envoys to Tang China again and again asking for aid, so that the Tang moved from harassment to invasion. The fourth was a calculation of Tang security: famine and a quarrel over the succession inside Goguryeo appeared at the same time, and pressure from the Tiele and Xueyantuo in the north made the Tang judge that this was the cheapest moment to strike. What held all this in check was logistics. The expedition went by sea and the grain came from Shandong; if the war could not be won quickly, it was the Tang army that would break first.
impact: 結果對唐與高句麗都是重創。645年唐軍無功而還，府庫耗於海運，山東、河北的轉輸之苦直達州縣，朝廷的東北用兵暫時收斂，改為小股襲擾與斷其糧道，直至647年再由牛進達、李世勣分海陸兩路進攻，648年薛萬徹渡海擊鴨綠水口，卻在太宗崩後停住。對高句麗而言，唐軍三次未能取下平壤，反而使國內的政變與派系鬥爭加速：淵蓋蘇文死後三子相爭，淵男生出奔，國中饑荒，邊防與政權同時崩壞。長期看，這場戰爭改變了整個東北亞的權力格局：663年唐與新羅、倭國舟師在白江擊敗百濟與倭國的聯合舟隊，百濟亡而新羅統一三韓的基礎由此成立；668年高句麗亡國，唐置安東都護府於平壤，一度把勢力伸到大同江以北，卻激起新羅的全力抵抗，676年終於罷安東都護府，改置羈縻性質的平壤大都督府，勢力退過大同江；698年震國建國，佔去高句麗故土的大部分，唐在東北亞的直接統治維持不到十年。留下的制度特點是：唐對這一地區的關係從帝國直轄轉為冊封、羈縻與外交並用，新羅與渤海先後被捲入唐的冊封體系，渤海於713年受封為渤海郡王。
impactEn: The outcome was a heavy blow to both Tang and Goguryeo. The Tang army returned from 645 with nothing achieved; the treasury was spent on the shipping, and the burden of carrying grain out of Shandong and Hebei fell directly on the prefectures and counties, so that the court's operations in the north-east drew in for a time and were reduced to small raids and the cutting of supplies, until in 647 Niu Jinda and Li Shiji advanced again by sea and by land, and in 648 Xue Wanche crossed the sea to strike at the mouth of the Yalu, only for the work to stop after the emperor's death. As for Goguryeo, three failures by the Tang to take Pyongyang actually accelerated the coup and the factional struggle inside the country: after Yu Ge Suwen's death his three sons fought, Yu Nan Seong fled out, famine swept the country, and the frontier and the government broke down together. In the long run the war rearranged the balance of the whole of Northeast Asia. In 663 the Tang, Silla and Japanese fleets met the combined Baekje-Japanese fleet at the Battle of Baekgang; Baekje was destroyed and the ground on which Silla would unify the Three Han was laid. In 668 Goguryeo fell, and the Tang set up the Protectorate General to Pacify the East at Pyongyang, pushing their power for a time north of the Taedong river, but this raised the full resistance of Silla, and in 676 the protectorate was abolished and replaced by the nominal Pyongyang commandery of the indirect-subordination type, the Tang falling back south of the Taedong. In 698 the state of Zhen was founded and took most of the old Goguryeo lands, and Tang rule in Northeast Asia proper lasted less than ten years. What it left behind was institutional: Tang relations with this region shifted from direct imperial rule to a mixture of investiture, of the indirect-subordination system and of diplomacy; Silla and then Balhae were drawn into the Tang investiture system, Balhae receiving the title of Prince of Bohai in 713.
result: 645年那一仗，唐軍破高句麗城十餘、平壤在望，卻在安市城前停下：城不下、糧道斷、嚴冬與薛延陀的牽制同時到來，太宗只有退兵，途中又有士卒死傷與糧船散失，高句麗並未屈服，唐太宗對自己的決策深自悔恨。往後十四年，雙方進入消耗：唐以三路大軍牽制高句麗，655年、658年、659年均取小勝，卻沒有一次能解決平壤；661年十餘萬大軍渡遼水合擊，因鐵勒入侵而全軍撤回；662年蛇水之戰更敗，沃沮道全軍覆沒，龐孝泰與十三個兒子盡死，說明遠征的極限在於時間與糧道，不在士氣。最後解決問題的不是唐軍的強攻，而是高句麗自己的崩解：666年淵蓋蘇文死，三子爭位，淵男生出降唐並提供內部情報，契苾何力率兵八萬接應，李勣以十五萬大軍並進，667年破新城，薛仁貴取南蘇、木底、蒼岩，668年越冬後合兵鴨綠水，新羅在南部同步進攻，九月十二日平壤城破，淵男建被俘，寶藏王與部分大臣降唐。高句麗國祚至此終結，其地分為九都督府、四十二州、一百縣，安東都護府於平壤設立。就兵器而言，這場戰爭說明的是弓弩的極限：亞述長弓所代表的複合反曲弓是最有效的守城與壓制武器，卻不能替攻城方解決糧道與季節的問題，最後決定平壤歸屬的，是糧秣、渡口與內部的裂痕。
resultEn: In 645 the Tang army had broken more than ten cities of Goguryeo and had Pyongyang in sight, and then it stopped before Anshi: the city would not fall, the supply line was cut, and the hard winter and the diversion created by Xueyantuo arrived together. The Taizong could only withdraw, with further losses of men and of grain ships on the way, and Goguryeo did not surrender; the Tang Taizong blamed his own decision deeply. For the next fourteen years the two sides ground each other down. The Tang pinned Goguryeo with armies moving on three roads and took small successes in 655, 658 and 659, but never once settled the question of Pyongyang. In 661 more than a hundred thousand men crossed the Liao river to converge on the city and were withdrawn again when the Tiele came over. In 662 there was a worse defeat at the river Snake, the whole Woju route army being destroyed and Pang Xiaotai perishing with his thirteen sons, which showed that the limit of the distant expedition lay in time and supply rather than in morale. What settled the matter in the end was not a Tang assault but the collapse of Goguryeo itself. In 666 Yu Ge Suwen died, his three sons fought over the succession, and Yu Nan Seong came over to the Tang with information from inside; Qibi Heli took eighty thousand men to meet him, Li Shiji advanced with a hundred and fifty thousand, Xincheng fell in 667, Xue Rengui took Nansu, Mudi and Cangyan, and after the winter of 668 the columns met on the Yalu while Silla attacked in the south. On the twelfth day of the ninth month Pyongyang was entered, Yu Nam Geon was taken prisoner, and the Treasure King with a number of his ministers surrendered. The state of Goguryeo thus came to an end, its territory divided into nine military districts, forty-two prefectures and a hundred counties, and the Protectorate General to Pacify the East established at Pyongyang. As for the weapons, what this war demonstrated was the limit of bow and crossbow: the composite recurved bow typified by the Assyrian bow on the card was the most effective instrument for holding a city and for pinning an attacker, but it could not solve the problems of supply and season for the side doing the assault, and what in the end decided the fate of Pyongyang was grain, the crossing points, and the cracks inside the enemy.
